quick: Massage gently into the scar two to three times daily
Do not use on open wounds
summary: Onion extract (Extractum cepae) is combined with heparin and allantoin in scar gels. It may modestly improve the appearance of hypertrophic scars; evidence is mixed.
indications: Hypertrophic scars and keloids (adjunct), post-surgical scars

dosage.d: Massage gently into the scar two to three times daily
dosage.n: Start once the wound has closed

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Anti-inflammatory and antiproliferative effects on fibroblasts (proposed).
preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
